aim.en: You can identify the boundary where legal compliance fails user needs and where design begins; prepare for and sit Kolokvijum 1.
aim.sr: Umeš da prepoznaš granicu gde puko zadovoljenje propisa izneverava potrebe korisnika i gde počinje projektovanje; priprema i polaganje Kolokvijuma 1.

bring.en: A3 portfolio of weeks 1–4, notebook, and drawing equipment.
bring.sr: A3 mapa vežbi iz nedelja 1–4, pribor za pisanje i crtanje.

text.en: Compliance is the floor, not the ceiling
text.sr: Propis je pod, a ne plafon

text.en: International standards (UN CRPD Art. 9, EN 17210:2021, ISO 21542:2021) demonstrate that spaces can be completely compliant on paper while failing real users in practice. Design quality begins where the checklist ends.
text.sr: Međunarodni standardi (UN Konvencija čl. 9, EN 17210:2021, ISO 21542:2021) pokazuju da prostor može formalno zadovoljiti propis na papiru, a u praksi biti neprijatan ili neupotrebljiv. Kvalitet projektovanja počinje tamo gde se lista propisa završava.

text.en: Accessibility is about making sure people can get in the door. Universal design is about making sure they want to be there.
text.sr: Pristupačnost osigurava da ljudi mogu da uđu na vrata. Univerzalni dizajn osigurava da žele da budu tu.

blocks.source: Edward Steinfeld & Jordana Maisel, Universal Design: Creating Inclusive Environments (2012)

text.en: Kolokvijum 1 is sat in the first hour: concepts and regulations. The second hour evaluates borderline cases.
text.sr: Kolokvijum 1 se radi u prvom satu: pojmovi i propisi. U drugom satu analiziramo granične slučajeve iz prakse.
